content:
As the iPhone Duo release date approaches, Apple is now accepting submissions for apps and games optimized for iPhone Duo, with development requiring the use of Xcode 27.1. Details are as follows.

App Store Connect will require iPhone Duo screenshots for submissions starting April 2027

Over the past few weeks, Apple has been progressively releasing Xcode 27.1 beta versions supporting the development and testing of iPhone Duo apps and games. Apple today released Xcode 27.1 Release Candidate 1, available for download here.

Apple earlier today published an article on its Developer News Hub, announcing that developers can now submit apps and games optimized for iPhone Duo via App Store Connect:

When you build or recompile using Xcode 27.1, your App Store product page will display a badge informing users that your app has been optimized for iPhone Duo.

Apple also specifically noted that starting April 2027, all apps or games submitted to App Store Connect must include screenshots suitable for iPhone Duo.

In the same announcement, Apple emphasized that recompiling existing apps with Xcode 27.1 is sufficient to add support for iPhone Duo development, and developers can preview their app's performance under various postures and orientations on the new device through the Device Hub.

Apple has also listed a number of resources to help developers prepare their apps and App Store product pages for iPhone Duo, including:

  • Access design guidelines and templates
  • Manage your App Store assets
  • View app preview specifications
  • View screenshot specifications

Apple will also host several in-person iPhone Duo workshops over the coming days; for details and registration, please click here.

iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can prepare for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12; for details, please click here.
